messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SLO breach detected for customer lighthouse-prod — p99 streaming latency 3.8s (SLO 1.5s), p95 1.2s. Affected route: /v1/stream/generate. First alert 2024-11-02T12:00:00Z
ryan (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. any customer impact notes?
iona (customer-success): Lighthouse support rep saying users report UI freezing and canceled requests. ~20% of sessions affected. They saw spikes starting ~11:58am UTC.
sarah (eng-sre): Looking at infra metrics — single-tenant pool for lighthouse shows saturation on GPU heap and request queue growth. concurrency peaking ~820. KV cache hit rate dropped from 78% -> 12%.
mike (runtime): We're seeing streaming stalls at tail tokens — long tail during prefix > 800 tokens and some hotprompt patterns with repeated system tokens \":::GAMMA:::\".
ryan (oncall): Could be prefix hotprompt causing KV cache thrash + batching skew. Can we throttle new sessions temporarily? Ops-bot, can we raise concurrency limit for this tenant's dedicated pool?
ops-bot: Action: Increased max_concurrency for tenant lighthouse-prod from 600 -> 900 for pool gwc-dedicated-07. Note: autoscale cooldown 30s.
sarah (eng-sre): Pushed a quick guard: per-tenant short-term ingress rate limit to 100rps with smoothing. Applied on edge route.
mike (runtime): Also enabling kv_prefix_short_circuit for lighthouse (config snippet): 
```json
{
  \"tenant\": \"lighthouse-prod\",
  \"kv_prefix_short_circuit\": true,
  \"kv_cache_ttl\": 120
}
```
ryan (oncall): Re-routed a percentage of traffic to fallback model rdx-small-quant (lower latency). Applied 20% canary. Monitor p99.
iona (customer-success): Informing lighthouse support: \"we've applied mitigations (temporary rate limit + model fallback). Expected partial relief in ~2m. We'll follow up with timeline.\" They asked for a status link.
ryan (oncall): status link: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/7865432100
sarah (eng-sre): Early signals: p99 dropped from 3.8s -> 1.9s after kv short-circuit + fallback. But streaming stalls still present for a subset of requests with prefix length > 1200.
mike (runtime): Captured sample logs of a stalled request:
```text
[2024-11-02T12:01:32Z] req=0x7f6a stalled at kv_fetch for prefix_id=gammapfx count=1 wait=2100ms
stack: serve_loop -> fetch_kv -> gpu_wait
```
ryan (oncall): Can we evict large prefixes or cap prefix length per-session for this tenant short-term?
sarah (eng-sre): Pushed a soft cap: reject prefixes > 1400 tokens with 429 + retry-after 30s. Communicated to ingress.
mike (runtime): Suggest we also scale up dedicated pool by +1 instance (same GPU shape). Requesting capacity from infra.
ops-bot: Provision request submitted to infra: instance add gwc-dedicated-07b (nvidia-a10x1). ETA ~90s.
iona (customer-success): Lighthouse rep: \"they can tolerate short 2-3 minute buffering, thanks for the quick action.\"
ryan (oncall): Logging mitigation steps in incident doc. Willes (next oncall) please handle handoff in 20min. @sarah please include root-cause hypotheses.
sarah (eng-sre): Hypothesis: unusual prompt tokens (\"::GAMMA::\" repeated) combined with long prefixes are causing KV cache fragmentation + long GPU kernel startup for certain attention patterns -> tail latency. Need to run a repro.
mike (runtime): I'll spin a repro job with 3 concurrent workers simulating lighthouse prompt family and measure kv hit patterns. Posting command:
```bash
./repro_sim.sh --tenant lighthouse --concurrency 3 --prompt-sample ./samples/gamma_set.json
```
ryan (oncall): Good. After infra scales and fallback, p99 now ~1.3s and p95 ~0.9s. Still monitoring for regressions.
sarah (eng-sre): Captured flame graphs and will attach to postmortem.
iona (customer-success): I'll schedule a customer follow-up and share TL;DR after incident closed.
ryan (oncall): Handoff to @willes (oncall2) in 20m. If anything spikes, page 2.4.
willes (oncall2): ack, will take over. Keep me in loop with repro artifacts.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigations active. Current severity: Sev2. Escalation if p99 >2.0s for 5m.
mike (runtime): Repro job started. initial run shows kv eviction thrash when prefix count > 250 unique prefixes per session.
sarah (eng-sre): Next steps: run controlled loadtest, patch kv cache LRU tuning, formal postmortem template.
ryan (oncall): Closing loop: customer notified, mitigation in place, handing off to willes & sarah for root cause and postmortem. I'll update incident doc and remove page once stable.
willes (oncall2): Taking handoff. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
